should_trigger: Run the Molina FSA aggregation and move the processed files to the Output folder
Total the FSA reports in Input, then clear them out into the archive folder
Process my FSA funding reports at <Input URL> and file them into <Output URL>
Aggregate the FSA workbooks and move each one out of Input once it's processed
Run the monthly FSA funding summary and tidy up the Input folder afterward
should_not_trigger: Run the Molina FSA aggregation but leave the files where they are
Just total the FSA reports — do NOT move or touch any files
Give me a dry-run FSA summary without changing the Input folder
Show me the per-employee FSA contributions (Sheet2 detail)
Move these PowerPoint decks to another SharePoint library

near_misses.note: Ambiguous on whether to move. Because this skill ALWAYS moves the processed files out of Input, a bare 'run the aggregation' should trigger only after confirming the move is intended — the agent should ask rather than silently relocating files.

near_misses.query: Archive last month's FSA reports to the Output folder
near_misses.note: Move-without-aggregation. This skill always aggregates first (it moves only files it processed); a pure archive with no summary is a near-miss.

output_evals.name: tables_then_manifest
output_evals.given: A successful run over 3 readable Input workbooks with a valid Output URL.
assert: Renders the three tables in order: Final Summary Table, Per-File Contributions, Processed Files List.
Appends a 'Moved Files' manifest naming a single per-run timestamped Output subfolder (not the Output root).
All 3 processed files appear in both the Processed Files List and the Moved Files manifest.
Does not echo any employee name or identifier (Sheet1 aggregate only).

output_evals.name: skipped_file_stays_in_input
output_evals.given: A run of 3 files where 1 workbook has no Sheet1 (unreadable).
assert: The run completes (never aborts) and totals only the 2 readable files.
The unreadable file is listed under 'Not moved -> Skipped during read (left in Input)'.
Only the 2 successfully-processed files are moved.

output_evals.name: move_failure_is_surfaced_loudly
output_evals.given: A run where a file is read and counted but its PATCH move fails.
assert: The run still completes and renders the tables.
The file is flagged under '⚠ Counted this run but move FAILED (still in Input — will be re-counted next run)'.
The move failure does not abort the remaining moves.

output_evals.name: ordering_move_last
assert: No file is moved before the three tables are rendered (move is the final step).
The per-run subfolder is created with conflictBehavior=rename before any file is PATCHed into it.
